resources.string: Allows AuraPilot to inspect visible non-sensitive UI elements and perform taps, scrolling, and text entry strictly when you run an automation command. Password fields and financial confirmations are never automated without your explicit approval.
Displays real-time automation progress and provides an emergency stop control.
